product_overview: A React-based consultancy website that lets visitors explore study-abroad services, destinations, consultants, and training offerings. It also includes an authenticated admin area for managing core website content and reviewing operational data.
core_goals: Browse the consultancy company’s public information and offerings
Learn about available services, destinations, consultants, and training options
Log in as an administrator to access protected management tools
Review dashboard overview metrics after authentication
Manage website content such as services, destinations, countries, bookings, FAQs, testimonials, and experts

features.name: Public Homepage Navigation
features.description: Visitors can access the main homepage and move through the public informational pages for the consultancy.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the homepage content -> Navigate to /about-us -> View company background -> Navigate to /services -> View offered services -> Navigate to /destinations -> View study destination options -> Navigate to /consultants -> View consultants information -> Navigate to /training -> View training services

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Administrators can authenticate with email and password to enter the protected dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in email address -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in email address -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See an error notification when the credentials are invalid

features.name: Admin Dashboard Overview
features.description: Authenticated administrators can view the main dashboard summary and statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View overview statistics and counts

features.name: Manage Services
features.description: Authenticated administrators can manage consultancy services from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/services -> View the services management page

features.name: Manage Countries
features.description: Authenticated administrators can manage country listings from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/countries -> View the countries management page

features.name: Manage Bookings
features.description: Authenticated administrators can review and manage booking records from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/bookings -> View the bookings management page

features.name: Manage FAQs
features.description: Authenticated administrators can manage frequently asked questions shown on the site.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/faqs -> View the FAQs management page

features.name: Manage Testimonials
features.description: Authenticated administrators can manage student testimonials displayed on the site.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/testimonials -> View the testimonials management page

features.name: Manage Experts
features.description: Authenticated administrators can manage experts and consultants listed on the site.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard/experts -> View the experts management page
